# Version 4.157.1 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan driver error recovery**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Imagination Vulkan allocation failures** — On affected Imagination drivers, Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors rather than destroying them unsafely. This deliberately forgoes pool cleanup; Graphite also rejects further allocations through the null pool handle. ([#5838](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5838))
